svg.text: Nellis AFB and the Nevada Test and Training Range - how a flight gets to the range and back. Not for real-world navigation.

g.text: NELLIS TERMINAL AREA - departures and recoveries
NELLIS TERMINAL AREA - departures and recoveries

svg.text: Lanes: BLUE transit corridor, GREEN departure, AMBER recovery; arrow = direction. A lane two
procedures share is drawn once and labelled twice.
Restricted area: navy, hatched inside the boundary - entry only when scheduled; the Box
(R-4808N) never. MOA: dashed magenta, joint use.
Gate ring = range entry/exit. Fix triangle. ~ = curated position or outline (the published
figure is a chart); R-4807A and R-4808N are the legal descriptions (60 FR 20635).
The overview draws departures and recoveries as dotted centerlines only; the terminal panels
draw them at several times the scale.

Sources: NELLISAFBI 11-250 · AFMAN 13-212V1 NTTR Add A · 99 ABW local procedures · Nellis/Creech/NTTR MACA pamphlet · 60 FR 20635 · vJaBoG66 Nevada FLIP · opennav.com · Not affiliated with Eagle Dynamics
